description: Shows an interactive CandidateFalcon practice game modeled on a HireVue game-based assessment. Available games: Numerosity, Flashback, Pathfinder, Digitspan, Puzzle Picture, Portrait, PortraitXT, Shapedance, E-Motions, Singularity, Teamchat. Without a game, shows a game picker. Opening a game only reads the account and plan and changes no data; the user plays in the interface. Requires a connected CandidateFalcon account with a games plan that includes HireVue, or Full Access. CandidateFalcon is an independent practice platform and is not affiliated with HireVue.
